an10.27:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an10.27:1.2: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhu pubbanha samayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya pavisiṃsu.
an10.27:1.5: yannūna mayaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyāmā”ti.
an10.27:2.1: atha kho te bhikkhu yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu.
an10.27:2.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhu te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etadavocuṃ.
an10.27:3.1: “samaṇo āvuso gotamo sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti:
an10.27:3.2: “etha tumhe bhikkhave sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānātha: sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya abhiññāya viharathā”ti.
an10.27:3.3: mayampi kho āvuso sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desema:
an10.27:3.4: “etha tumhe āvuso sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānātha: sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya abhiññāya viharathā”ti.
an10.27:3.5: idha no āvuso ko viseso, ko adhippāyo, kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ samaṇassa vā gotamassa amhākaṃ vā yadidaṃ dhammadesanāya vā dhammadesanaṃ, anusāsaniyā vā anusāsaninti”?
an10.27:4.1: atha kho te bhikkhu tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ neva abhinandiṃsu na paṭikkosiṃsu,
an10.27:4.3: bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmāti.
an10.27:5.1: atha kho te bhikkhu sāvatthiyaṃ piṇaṇḍāya caritvā pacchā bhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
an10.27:6.1: idha mayaṃ bhante, pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā patta cīvaramādāya sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya pavisimha.
an10.27:6.4: yannūna mayaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyāmā”ti.
an10.27:6.5: atha kho mayaṃ bhante yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo, tenupasaṅkamimha. upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodimha.
an10.27:6.6: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdimha. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho bhante aññatitthiyā paribbājakā amhe etadavocuṃ:
an10.27:7.1: “samaṇo āvuso gotamo sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti:
an10.27:7.2: ‘etha tumhe bhikkhave sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānātha, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya abhiññāya viharathā’ti.
an10.27:7.3: mayampi kho āvuso sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desema:
an10.27:7.4: “etha tumhe āvuso sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānātha, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya abhiññāya viharathā’ti.
an10.27:7.5: idha no āvuso ko viseso, ko adhippāyo kiṃnānā karaṇaṃ, samaṇassa vā gotamassa amhākaṃ vā yadidaṃ dhammadesanāya vā dhammadesanaṃ anusāsaniyā vā anusāsaninti”.
an10.27:8.1: atha kho mayaṃ bhante tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandimha, na paṭikkosimha.
an10.27:9.1: evaṃ vādino bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evamassu vacanīyā:
an10.27:9.2: “eko āvuso pañho, eko uddeso, ekaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ, dve pañhā, dve uddesā, dve veyyākaraṇāni, tayo pañhā, tayo uddesā tīṇi veyyākaraṇāni, cattāro pañhā, cattāro uddesā, cattāri veyyākaraṇāni, pañca pañhā, pañcuddesā, pañca veyyākaraṇāni, cha pañhā, cha uddesā, cha veyyākaraṇāni, satta pañhā, satta uddesā, satta veyyākaraṇāni, aṭṭha pañhā, aṭṭha uddesā, aṭṭha veyyākaraṇāni, nava pañhā, nava uddesā, nava veyyākaraṇāni, dasa pañhā, dasuddesā, dasa veyyākaraṇānīti.
an10.27:9.3: evaṃ puṭṭho bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā na ceva sampāyissanti, uttariñca vighātaṃ āpajjissanti.
an10.27:9.6: nāhantaṃ bhikkhave passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇa brāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadeva manussāya, yo imesaṃ pañhānaṃ veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheyya, aññatra tathāgatena vā tathāgatasāvakena vā, ito vā pana sutvā.
an10.27:10.1: eko pañho, eko uddeso, ekaṃ veyyākaraṇanti
an10.27:10.2: iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
an10.27:10.3: ekadhamme bhikkhave bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti,
an10.27:10.6: imasmiṃ kho bhikkhave ekadhamme bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti.
an10.27:10.7: eko pañho, eko uddeso, ekaṃ veyyākaraṇanti
an10.27:10.8: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an10.27:11.1: dve pañhā, dve uddesā, dve veyyākaraṇānīti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ
an10.27:11.3: dvīsu bhikkhave dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti,
an10.27:11.6: imesu kho bhikkhave dvīsu dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti.
an10.27:11.7: dve pañhā, dve uddesā. dve veyyākaraṇānīti iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭiccavuttaṃ.
an10.27:12.1: tayo pañhā, tayo uddesā, tayo veyyākaraṇānīti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ
an10.27:12.3: tīsu bhikkhave dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti,
an10.27:12.6: imesu kho bhikkhave tīsu dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti.
an10.27:12.7: tayo pañhā, tayo uddesā. tīṇi veyyākaraṇānīti iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭiccavuttaṃ.
an10.27:13.1: cattāro pañhā, cattāro uddesā, cattāri veyyākaraṇānīti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ,
an10.27:13.3: catusu bhikkhave dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti.
an10.27:13.6: imesu kho bhikkhave catusu dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti.
an10.27:13.7: cattāro pañhā, cattāro uddesā. cattāri veyyākaraṇānīti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭiccavuttaṃ.
an10.27:14.1: pañca pañhā, pañcuddessā, pañca veyyākaraṇānīti. iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ,
an10.27:14.3: pañcasu bhikkhave dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti.
an10.27:14.6: imesu kho bhikkhave pañcasu dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti.
an10.27:14.7: pañca pañhā, pañcuddesā pañcaveyyākaraṇānīti. iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭiccavuttaṃ.
an10.27:15.1: cha pañhā, cha uddesā cha veyyākaraṇānīti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ,
an10.27:15.3: chasu bhikkhave dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti,
an10.27:15.6: imesu kho bhikkhave chasu dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti.
an10.27:15.7: ja pañhā, ja uddesā, ja veyyākaraṇānīti. iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an10.27:16.1: satta pañhā satta uddesā satta veyyākaraṇānīti. iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ,
an10.27:16.3: sattasu bhikkhave dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti.
an10.27:16.6: imesu kho bhikkhave sattasu dhammesu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti. sattapañhā,
an10.27:16.7: satta uddesā, satta veyyākaraṇānīti. iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an10.27:17.1: aṭṭha pañhā aṭṭhuddesā, aṭṭha veyyākaraṇānīti. iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ
an10.27:17.3: aṭṭhasu bhikkhave dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti.
an10.27:17.6: imesu kho bhikkhave aṭṭhasu dhammesu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti.
an10.27:17.7: aṭṭha pañhā aṭṭhuddesā aṭṭha veyyākaraṇānīti. iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an10.27:18.1: nava pañhā, nava uddesā, nava veyyākaraṇānīti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ,
an10.27:18.3: navasu bhikkhave dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti.
an10.27:18.6: imesu kho bhikkhave navasu dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammāvimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti.
an10.27:18.7: nava pañhā, nava uddesā nava veyyākaraṇānīti iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an10.27:19.2: iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an10.27:19.3: dasasu bhikkhave dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti,
an10.27:19.6: imesu kho bhikkhave dasasu dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti.
an10.27:19.8: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttanti.
